about: credits engine style coin: treasury contract as bounty recipient and only credits style coin with the treasury as bounty recipient. Not restricted (plain erc20 transfers). native eth pool, 69 minute linear anti sniper skim from 68.69% down to the 6% baseline. For a restricted coin set restriction.restricted true and list any extra allowlist entries in restriction.allowed; the factory seeds the allowlist with this launch's locker, the launch extensions and the entries of restriction.allowed. Routers and forwarders, including Permit2 and the universal router, are never allowlisted, because the transfer rule checks the sender and the recipient only and an allowlisted forwarder moves the coin between any wallets. A restricted coin moves between allowlisted wallets by direct transfer. Replace every treasury placeholder (0x7ea5...0001) with the real treasury contract and set example to false before a broadcast.

mev.note: startingSkimBps and windowSeconds are required when a mev module is set
